splits.reason: The generic dashboard label mixes the board-per-domain IA with the widget catalog that fills it.
A chart-types umbrella spans grammar/library choice and several concrete mark families.
Widget catalogs include chart widgets and non-chart panels; split by whether the widget is a mark.
status is both a per-node status grid encoding and a top-level degraded/health banner.
metrics is the provenance/attribution fact and the time-series mark that draws it.
monitoring covers agent instrumentation and the alerting surface built on it.
logs are the live stream surface and a provenance-bearing record.
cost tracking is a money surface and a provenance/attribution fact.
alerting covers the attention surface and spend/budget thresholds.
The accessibility label spans SVG alternatives, focus/ARIA, color safety and motion.
motion is both the easing system and its reduced-motion escape hatch.
Labels naming an implementation stack or a single source's marketing copy (react, tailwind, terminal-craft, ...) are counted but not clustered as techniques.

merges.reason: Every live-stream label denotes one log/event surface; merged so support reflects the surface.
All large-tabular labels merged into the virtualized-table cluster.
Board labels merged; the widget catalog they contain is the separate ia-widget-catalog node.
Thin synonymous widget/panel catalogs across F2/F3/F4 merged.
Token/theming synonyms merged; dark-first is a value of the token system, not a separate cluster.
Trace-tree labels merged into the causal-lineage cluster (the waterfall mark stays in viz-timeline-gantt).
Terminal pane/tab labels merged into one navigation cluster.
Every eval/dataset/experiment label merged into one eval-loop cluster.
Thin micro-mark labels merged; they share the no-JS-runtime SVG/CSS craft.
Color labels merged into the colorblind-safe-status cluster.

nodes.note: The whole 5-family corpus. Nodes overlap: a record may appear in several clusters.
